title: Near a regular point the density is a constant positive integer on the support
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and let y ∈ reg T (regularSet T, Simon 7.4.1 as in the contract: y ∈ spt T and for some ρ₀ > 0 with B_{ρ₀}(y) ⊆ U, some m₀ ∈ ℤ ∖ {0} and some embedded C¹ n-dimensional submanifold M ∋ y with a continuous orientation ξ (IsOrientation) and H^n(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ B_{ρ₀}(y), T(ω) = m₀∫_M ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH^n(x) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_{ρ₀}(y)). Then there are m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1 and ρ > 0 such that HasMassDensity T z m (Θ^n(μ_T, z) = m) for every z ∈ spt T ∩ B_ρ(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P), IsOpen U → y ∈ regularSet T → ∃ (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 1 ≤ m ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z ∈ T.support ∩ ball y ρ, HasMassDensity T z m
